(Japanese: ３人の刺客 The Three Assassins) is the 58th chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
The remaining Seven Warriors and the Three Generals are revealed.
Kigyan, Lukov, and Toga, in a fit of boredom and anger, decide to take over Great Gavel.
The Three Generals receives the Burst Hearts containing , , and .
Gerubu brands Kigyan, Lukov, and Toga as traitors and commands the Three Generals to get rid of them.
